summary: Gone lookout on Eagle Nest Butte, Jackson County, South Dakota, on the Pine Ridge Indian Reservation; no build, design or staffing history found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. No source describes what remains on the butte.

evidence.supports: about seven miles south of Wanblee
site on the Pine Ridge Indian Reservation

notes_for_editor: Access stays unknown and should not be marked public: the site is on the Pine Ridge Indian Reservation and no source gives a visitor rule. Elevation disagrees: the lookout page says 3410 ft (about 1,039 m), Mapcarta's peak listing says 3,396 ft (1,035 m). The record's elevation_m is null and was not set. Mapcarta's longitude (-101.6557) is about 0.004 degrees east of the record (-101.6597), roughly 300 m; the record's FFLA point was kept. Build date, design, staffing and fire history: none found in one search and four page reads, so the story is short. Tribal records would be the next place to look.
